summary.scope: All explicit current JK/MotS Massassi package roots; passive ZIP/GOB/GOO traversal; native declared/header metadata and private readme text; no game execution; damaged and unsupported nested containers listed separately
summary.count_definition: Occurrences are archive member occurrences, including duplicate, stock, scenery and weapon assets. Distinct hashes are byte-identical deduplication, not counts of characters. Only selected model/skin/weapon cases received interpretive review.

inventory_limitations: ZIP/GOB/GOO traversal depth at most 6; 2 GiB member budget; ZIP ratio budget 1000
Nested EXE/RAR/7Z were not expanded by this pass. An excluded EXE may be an ancillary patch program, not a missing model archive.
Unsupported signatures, legacy compression, encryption, damaged members and nesting exclusions are recorded per package.
3DO and KEY fields are declarations, not a full grammar or geometry validity proof. MAT/CMP fields in this broad scan are headers only; selected material reports validate more of their payloads.
Repeated GOB member names can be ambiguous; selected member verification resolves by exact member SHA-256.
Catalog coverage is the nine selected JK/MotS Massassi game-package categories, not every site resource, forum or Discord attachment.
